papers.title: A design science approach to scaling platform business models
papers.abstract: Platform business models are central to the digital economy, yet few achieve sustainable scaling—exponential expansion combined with resource-efficient value creation. Existing research highlights the role of business model design choices and managerial agency in shaping scaling outcomes but offers limited insight into how scalable configurations are generated under uncertainty. We address this question by adopting a design science perspective on platform scaling. A multi-case study of four platforms demonstrates how the DSR framework explains the iterative generation and refinement of scalable platform configurations.
papers.summary_ja: プラットフォームビジネスモデルのスケーリングにデザインサイエンス視点を導入し、不確実性下で持続可能な拡張構成を生成する方法論的フレームワークをマルチケース研究から提示する。

papers.title: Transforming the business model innovation process: how generative artificial intelligence shapes value creation, delivery, and capture
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines how Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) may transform the Business Model Innovation (BMI) process and under which conditions it may reshape core Business Model (BM) mechanisms. Design/methodology/approach A systematic literature review of 131 peer-reviewed articles was conducted. Using the Gioia methodology in an abductive analysis, with the 4I-framework of BMI as a sensitizing lens, an integrative framework was developed to synthesize GenAI's role across BMI phases.
papers.summary_ja: 131本の査読論文のシステマティックレビューを通じて、生成AIがBMIの価値創造・提供・獲得メカニズムをどう変革するかを4I-フレームワークで統合的に整理した。

papers.title: Peer benchmarking and digital upgrading: Field experiments on business websites
papers.abstract: Can low-cost comparative information trigger firms to improve the performance of a digital asset they already own? Using two large-scale randomised controlled trials with approximately 7000 UK firms in the distilling and retail sectors, we study whether peer benchmarking of website performance prompts measurable improvement. Firms receiving benchmarked website metrics and targeted recommendations exhibit modest average improvements, with more favourable effects among initially underperforming firms.
papers.summary_ja: 約7,000社のUK企業を対象とした大規模RCTにより、ピアベンチマーク情報の提供が企業のデジタル資産パフォーマンス改善を誘発することを実証した稀有な政策介入実験。

papers.title: De-Sludging High-Friction Frontlines: Designing an AI-Mediated Service Gateway for Mental Health
papers.abstract: Nearly one billion people suffer from mental disorders globally, yet 35 to 85 percent receive no treatment even when services are available, affordable, and known to them. This paradox suggests that the primary barrier to utilization is not only structural supply failure but also behavioral friction at the mental health service entry threshold. Drawing on sludge theory and administrative burden research, we conceptualize these barriers as service sludge—cognitive, emotional, and process friction—and propose an AI-mediated service gateway framework to address them.
papers.summary_ja: メンタルヘルスサービスにおける「サービス・スラッジ（認知・感情・プロセス摩擦）」を概念化し、AI媒介型サービスゲートウェイによる摩擦除去フレームワークをスラッジ理論と行政負担研究から構築。

papers.title: Dynamic Capabilities and Strategic Performance Under Polycrisis: The Roles of Strategic Flexibility and Regenerative Capability
papers.abstract: Firms increasingly face polycrisis environments in which geopolitical, climate, technological, and supply chain disruptions interact and cascade. Drawing on the dynamic capability view, the study examines how strategic flexibility and regenerative capability relate to strategic performance and how their values vary with polycrisis intensity. Survey data from 780 Indian manufacturing firms are analyzed using partial least squares-based structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) and permutation analysis.
papers.summary_ja: インド製造業780社のPLS-SEM分析により、地政学・気候・テクノロジー・SCの複合危機（ポリクライシス）下で戦略的柔軟性と再生的ケイパビリティが戦略的パフォーマンスに与える役割を実証した。

papers.title: Don't call it a circular business model: establishing boundary conditions to clarify conceptual ambiguity in circular economy research
papers.abstract: The circular economy literature has increasingly relied on the concept of Circular Business Model (CBM) to describe firm-level circular initiatives. However, this broad labelling tendency risks conflating genuine business model innovation with functional improvements more accurately described as Circular Operations Strategies (COS). Through a critical analysis of 28 studies proposing and adopting CBM archetypes, we assess 272 configurations against criteria drawn from the management literature.
papers.summary_ja: 28研究・272設定の批判的分析により、「サーキュラー・ビジネスモデル（CBM）」と「サーキュラー・オペレーション戦略（COS）」の概念的境界条件を確立し、サーキュラーエコノミー研究の概念的曖昧さを解消する。

papers.title: Blurring Boundaries: Exploring public exhibition as a design research method for speculating on hospital-in-the-home futures
papers.abstract: As designers work in increasingly complex contexts such as healthcare, methods are needed to engage diverse publics in collective futuring. This paper positions the interactive public exhibition as a design research method, using Blurring Boundaries as a research-through-design case to demonstrate how speculation can support collaborative inquiry across knowledge boundaries. Over five days, more than 80 designers, architects, clinicians, patient advocates, health-service leaders, students and visitors participated.
papers.summary_ja: RtD（Research through Design）の一手法として、医療・在宅ケアの未来に関するインタラクティブ展示を実施し、80名超の多様なステークホルダーが知識境界を超えて未来を共創するプロセスを分析した事例研究。

papers.title: Navigating personal control: AI augmentation and its impact on decision-making
papers.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in organisational decision-making, it fundamentally reshapes workers' personal control over their tasks and outcomes. While, in contrast to AI automation, AI augmentation is typically promoted as a way to preserve human agency and personal control, empirical evidence regarding its psychological consequences remains fragmented. This study adopts Control Theory to examine how varying degrees of AI involvement, conceptualised as a continuum, affect workers' sense of personal control.
papers.summary_ja: コントロール理論を援用し、AIオーグメンテーションとAIオートメーションが従業員の個人的コントロール感覚に与える異なる心理的影響を実証。AIの関与度を連続体として捉えた新規フレームワークを提示する。

papers.title: Design Thinking–Driven Multi-Agent Method for Persona Generation
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Personas are widely used in user-centered design, yet conventional persona construction remains labor-intensive, difficult to update, and weak in evidence traceability. This study proposes a Design Thinking-driven multi-agent method for persona generation, organizing the Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test stages into a closed-loop workflow. Within this workflow, raw research materials are progressively transformed into structured evidence, requirement hypotheses, persona drafts, visualizations, and validation feedback.
papers.summary_ja: デザイン思考の5ステップを閉ループワークフローとして構成したマルチエージェントAIによるペルソナ自動生成手法を提案し、従来手法の労働集約性・更新困難性・根拠追跡の弱さを克服する。

papers.title: Understanding the spillover effect of personal AI use on service innovation: the role of psychological capital and conscientiousness
papers.abstract: Purpose As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in everyday life and workplace operations, research has begun to document numerous organizational benefits, including enhanced efficiency and productivity. However, employees' personal experiences with AI and how these experiences spill over into the work domain remain underexplored. Using sociomateriality as a sensitizing lens, we propose and test a sequential process in which personal AI use increases work-related AI use, further enhancing employees' psychological capital, ultimately improving their service innovation performance.
papers.summary_ja: 日常的なAI利用（個人レベル）が職場のAI活用・心理的資本向上を経由してサービスイノベーション行動に波及するプロセスを、ソシオマテリアリティ視点から実証した。
